queue.title: Waiting-room screens
queue.lead: A TV in the waiting room shows the patient going in now with the room number, then the next patient and two waiting. It refreshes every 2 seconds and chimes on every change.
queue.empty_text: Add a screen and open its link on the waiting-room TV.
queue.add_sub: Each screen has its own secret link. It opens only on a device where an owner or clinic manager signed in once.
queue.names_help: Short names protect patients' privacy (first name + family initial).
queue.created: Screen added. Open its link on the TV.
queue.regenerated: New link created; the old link stopped working.
queue.rooms_sub: The room number shows on the screen next to the patient name. Set it on the doctor's page.
queue.no_room_help: For doctors without a room number, the screen shows the doctor's name instead.
queue.how_1: Add a screen and copy its link.
queue.how_2: On the TV's browser: sign in as the owner or clinic manager, open the link, then sign out — the TV keeps the screen. Press Full screen.
queue.how_3: Tap the screen once to turn the sound on (a browser rule).
queue.how_4: At the front desk: Check in adds the patient to the queue; Send in shows them as “Please go in” with the room number.
queue.security: The link alone does not open the screen: only a device an owner or clinic manager authorised. The screen only shows the names in the queue and never opens the system. Press New link to stop every authorised device.
queue.gone: This screen was turned off or its link changed.
queue.tap_to_start: Tap to start the screen and sound
queue.voice: Read the patient's name and room aloud
queue.voice_help: After the ding-dong the screen says: “Lina, please go to Room 1”. Turn it off to keep the chime only. Needs a browser with voices (Chrome or Edge).

screens_hdr.message: Message in the middle of the top
screens_hdr.message_help: Shown in the middle of the top of the screen. Leave empty to hide it, or pick a ready message.

preset.phone: Please keep your phone on silent
